differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Long‑standing type 2 diabetes with micro‑ and macro‑albuminuria and progressive CKD stage 4 is classic.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Chronic uncontrolled hypertension in a Black patient contributes to arteriolar sclerosis and CKD progression.

differential.name: Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS)
differential.rationale: African descent, proteinuria, and CKD without overt diabetic control issues raise suspicion for primary/secondary FSGS.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: CKD stage 4 commonly causes reduced erythropoietin production leading to anemia.

differential.name: Secondary dyslipidemia (hypercholesterolemia)
differential.rationale: Markedly elevated LDL and total cholesterol are typical in CKD and diabetes, contributing to cardiovascular risk.
